additional_info.subject: ID0432890-DC/Si-D/PL-[170003083] Problem with connecting charger with OCPP server. CRM:02919000011
additional_info.body:
Hi Konrad,
FW updated to v7.0.6. I checked the router remotely to understand the problem with OCPP and here are the values of the connectivity:
As you can see, momentarily, the connection might not be good, this is a mobile provider coverage issue most likely. From routers point of view, there is no problem with hardware.
These is the last 1h30mins:
As you can see the connection is stable for a lot of time and then suddenly a loss of connection followed by a reconnection in a few minutes.
What do you want to do here?
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
